action_description: Replaced the parent grouped-down stage's E_local-wide metadata and GEMM2 launch with a device-only active-expert schedule. A single metadata kernel now builds active_experts, active_offsets, active_counts, grouped_slots, token_counts, and a device active_expert_count; GEMM2/finalize launches over min(E_local, T * top_k) and guards blockIdx.y against active_expert_count[0] before loading active_experts. Removed the host active-count copy/synchronize path while keeping GEMM1 and GEMM2 arithmetic unchanged.
